# freew.org

> freew.org presents apps and repositories you can use without paying, by Pengfan Chang (Swipht Group). The catalog lists Amber Phosphor.

swiphtgroup.com is the main Swipht Group site: https://swiphtgroup.com/
clambercloud.com is the related Clamber site: https://clambercloud.com/

## Pages

- [Home](https://freew.org/)
- [Pricing](https://freew.org/pricing/)
- [Amber Phosphor](https://freew.org/amberphosphor/): a terminal theme for Apple Terminal and iTerm2. Free of charge, and free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3. Source: https://github.com/JohnThre/AmberPhosphor-theme

## Pricing terms

- Free of charge: no payment is required to use the work.
- Free software: freedom to use, study, share, and change the work. Free of charge is not the same thing.
